name: tabbrew
description: Generate and run TabBrew Scripts to organize, group, pin, move, or close Chrome tabs from natural-language goals. Trigger when the user asks to manage Chrome tabs — e.g. "organize my tabs", "close all YouTube tabs", "group my Chrome tabs by domain", "clean up tabs", "pin/unpin/move/delete tabs", or mentions TabBrew explicitly. Best fit for any tab-management task in Chrome.
